description: Safety number v2 (Signal NumericFingerprint) and verification QR vectors. Hex unless noted. Regenerate/verify with scripts/safety-number-vectors.mjs.

construction.fingerprint: h = SHA-512(u16be(version) || identityKey(32) || utf8(userId)); repeat iterations times h = SHA-512(h || identityKey); 30 digits = h[0..30] as six 5-byte big-endian integers, each mod 100000, zero-padded to 5 digits.
construction.safetyNumber: The two 30-digit fingerprints joined, lexicographically smaller first.
construction.qrPayload: base64url-nopad("VEILSN" || u8(version) || localKey(32) || u8(len) || utf8(localUserId) || remoteKey(32) || u8(len) || utf8(remoteUserId)). A scanner accepts only the role-swapped payload of its own view.

userIdBinding.note: alice's identity key with bob's userId

versionBinding.note: alice's identity and userId under version 3
